reason: FR-118's 'a closed price never shown live' is violated, but by a different and wider mechanism than cited. The 'no cue anywhere' claim is wrong in part: Equity Overview renders a provenance+freshness chip (live/stale/eod, stale in warning tone) and the screener header renders a data-tier freshness/as-of line; only Portfolio has no cue, and none of the three uses the session label helpers. The real defect: quotes.py stamps freshness via freshness_for(config.get_region(), ...), i.e. against the USER's locale calendar, not the instrument's exchange, so under the IN locale during Indian market hours a closed US quote is labelled 'live' (reproduced), and since isLiveQuote keys on freshness === 'live' even the chart/watchlist surfaces that ARE wired treat it as a live tick. Fix: derive the calendar region from the instrument (resolver region/exchange) in _label_freshness, then roll the session label into Portfolio/Equity Overview.
